method: Compared the lesson with Anthropic Handle tool calls and Define tools docs; ran the SHA-pinned offline verifier under Python 3.10 with Pydantic 2.9.2. The verifier executes both Python examples, checks exact published stdout, exercises fake tool_use/tool_result rounds, retry exhaustion, stop reasons, redaction and fallback behavior, and propagation of transport errors to the outer runtime. No provider/network calls.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 retry trajectories, exact prompts, model revision and scorer are not present, so historical 0/6, 4/6 and 6/6 outcomes were not reproduced or confirmed.
The fake client verifies local control flow and message shape only; no live Anthropic, DeepSeek, proxy, provider-side tool parsing or model correction behavior was tested.
The degradation example emits a field-level dispatch plan but does not implement the downstream worker, human queue, ACL store or production retention policy.
The verifier checks Pydantic 2.9.2 local validation and redaction; production business validators, sensitive-data classification and task-specific risk policy remain application responsibilities.
